title: Bill record
description: One historical billing-period record for a single utility/household bill. See billing/README.md for how this store is populated and its current limitations.

id.description: Stable unique identifier for this bill record, e.g. `<utility_type>-<period_end>`.

utility_type.description: One of the household's tracked bill categories.

period_start.description: Billing period start date (ISO 8601), if known.

period_end.description: Billing period end date (ISO 8601), if known.

issue_date.description: Date the bill was issued, if known.

usage.description: Metered usage for the period, when applicable (electricity kWh, gas MJ, water kL, etc). Omit or null when not applicable/known.

original_cost.description: Original / pre-discount cost, if the source document distinguishes it from the final payable amount. Null when the source only gives one figure.

discounts.description: Total discounts/credits applied for the period, if known. Null rather than 0 when the source does not state a discount explicitly — never fabricate a savings figure.

final_amount.description: Final amount payable for this bill.

payment_status.description: User-controlled. Never set to 'paid' automatically by an ingestion process — see README.

paid_date.description: Date the user marked this bill Paid, if applicable.

extraction_confidence.description: Set by an ingestion pipeline (BILL-003) when a record was produced from automated extraction rather than manual entry. 'review_required' means one or more fields are uncertain and must not be trusted until a human confirms them.

source.description: Traceability back to where this record came from.

reference.description: A non-sensitive pointer to the source (e.g. a message/file id), never the document content or an account/customer identifier.
